episode.subject: Chrysochroa fulgidissima
episode.title: A firm grip
episode.body: On my first flight, the trunk dropped away beneath me. I went after it and caught the bark with all six feet. The tree stopped. I stayed there for a while, very pleased with myself.

proposals.imageReview: PASS recommendation. Exact 1024 x 576 source-published large image opened individually. Wing covers, segmented abdomen and bark are crisp; translucent wings show motion blur consistent with beating wings. This is deliberate event detail, not overall softness. Foot contact with bark remains visible. Companion 386877466 shows a closed-wing beetle on the trunk but is not used as a second entry or a proven chronological sequence. Original upload metadata 1365 x 768 is recorded separately; no claim that the larger original was downloaded. No crop or image manipulation.
proposals.proseAssessment: PASS recommendation for independent review. The novice mistakes optic motion during his own flight for the tree moving, returns to its bark, and takes credit for stopping it. This is an embodied error with an immediate action and private satisfaction. It develops his uncertainty about adult experience without another color lecture, praise of his beauty, remembered wood meal or camera encounter. It does not recycle Greta biting after release: Akio acts on apparent movement and believes he has rescued the tree. The final sentence describes his state without explaining the optical error or adding a moral.

holds.title: The last feet
holds.body: Before I had wings, Pip climbed over me to reach the next leaf. I meant to complain. By the time his last feet had gone, I was hoping he'd forgotten something.
holds.verdict: HOLD repetition. A clear two-larva contact image exists, but the affection after irritation repeats Careful affection and the broader crowded-nettle/longing-for-interruption history. Preserve this attempt without admission.
